title: His large family and the bandleader 'Two Roads'
summary: He had ten siblings, mostly living nearby; asked about a bandleader of a similar name, he says he knows no such person and claims he put every musician before the public.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Yeah. And did you have a big family? Lots of family?
I had six sisters. I mean seven sisters and three brothers.
Oh, that's a good size. Ten. Yeah, that's a good size family.
It's a great family. I got six living now and one Eve. Six sisters living and one Eve.
Oh, there's still most of them. Most of them lived in this neighborhood? They lived right back to St. Phil's.
Everybody lived in the same neighborhood. Well, I want to ask you, did you ever hear a band leader named Two Roads?
No, there never was nobody ever was in a Two Roads when connected with men.
